evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth, 3.19→3.53 Torr (k=20→26), while Ar flow (~100 sccm) and T (750 °C) are on setpoint
O2 sensor not installed, so an air in-leak cannot be distinguished from an exhaust restriction
Heater power stable ~44%, no thermal anomaly

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (or a downstream RGA/leak check) plus a brief Ar setpoint step to see whether pressure tracks flow: flow-independent rise implies a leak, exaggerated rise implies exhaust blockage.
